assumptions: notes.txt is meant to hold human-readable notes, so punctuation fidelity is safe to preserve.

decisions.choice: Added a terminating period to the single line in notes.txt.
decisions.whyItMatters: Keeps the note a complete, readable sentence without changing its meaning.

alternatives.option: Leave the line unchanged and make no edit.
alternatives.consequence: The note would remain a sentence fragment and the phase would produce no change.

alternatives.option: Append a new second line of commentary.
alternatives.consequence: Would alter the file's scope beyond a single safe one-line edit.

recommendation.reason: It is the smallest possible safe change that still improves the note.
